summary: Initializes a 4x4 matrix at a1 to a diagonal form. Row-major elements: (0,0) = a2, (1,1) = a3, (2,2) = a4, (3,3) = 1.0, with every other element zeroed as a float. Writes occur at byte offsets 0x0..0x3C (element stride 4 bytes). Returns the original a1 pointer. Structurally a twin of F_4x4MatrixMultiply (0050cbb6) per the cluster prelabel.

local_names.a2: value stored to the (0,0) diagonal element
local_names.a3: value stored to the (1,1) diagonal element
local_names.a4: value stored to the (2,2) diagonal element

operations.description: Matrix row 0: store a2 as the DWORD at offset 0x0 and zero floats at offsets 0x4, 0x8, 0xC, 0x10.
Matrix row 1: store a3 as the DWORD at offset 0x14 and zero floats at offsets 0x18, 0x1C, 0x20, 0x24.
Matrix row 2: store a4 as the DWORD at offset 0x28 and zero floats at offsets 0x2C, 0x30, 0x34, 0x38.
Matrix row 3: store the constant 1.0 at offset 0x3C (homogeneous diagonal element).
Return the original a1 pointer unchanged.
